replays.title: Replay: Bullish Trend Structure: EUR/USD
replays.questionText: Observe the swing sequence across this 16-candle chart on EUR/USD. What is the primary structural condition?
options: Valid Uptrend (Consecutive Higher Highs & Higher Lows)
Sideways Consolidation / Rangebound Equilibrium
Valid Downtrend (Consecutive Lower Highs & Lower Lows)
High-Volatility Structural Expansion with no trend
replays.correctAnswer: Valid Uptrend (Consecutive Higher Highs & Higher Lows)
replays.explanation: Price displays structural integrity with clear higher peaks (HH) at candles 3, 9, 16 and ascending troughs (HL) at candles 5, 12. This confirms an active Bullish Trend.

replays.title: Replay: Bearish Trend Structure: AUD/USD
replays.questionText: Analyze the price sequence on AUD/USD. What market regime is in progress?
options: Valid Downtrend (Consecutive Lower Highs & Lower Lows)
Bullish Accumulation Base with expanding highs
Horizontal Range with equal reaction boundaries
Trendless Choppy Rotation around Mean
replays.correctAnswer: Valid Downtrend (Consecutive Lower Highs & Lower Lows)
replays.explanation: Each rally terminates lower than the previous swing peak (LH at candles 5, 12), while selloffs breach prior valleys to print Lower Lows (LL). This confirms an active Bearish Downtrend.

replays.title: Replay: Rangebound Consolidation: EUR/JPY
replays.questionText: Price is repeatedly rejecting near 1.1058 and bouncing near 1.0942. What is the market state?
options: Horizontal Range / Consolidation between defined boundaries
Parabolic Bullish Trend with exponential expansion
Aggressive Bearish Breakdown into fresh territory
Random Walk without identifiable structural levels
replays.correctAnswer: Horizontal Range / Consolidation between defined boundaries
replays.explanation: Price displays symmetrical oscillation between clear horizontal Support (~1.0950) and Resistance (~1.1050) with no sustained displacement outside the boundaries.
